mainEntity.name: What are the primary benefits of installing artificial turf?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artificial turf offers significant advantages for property owners. It drastically reduces water consumption, leading to lower utility bills and environmental benefits, especially in drought-prone areas like Los Angeles. Maintenance requirements are minimal, eliminating the need for mowing, fertilizing, or pesticides. This frees up time and resources, while providing a consistently lush, green appearance year-round, regardless of climate or foot traffic. Its durability makes it ideal for high-use areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Artificial turf saves water, reduces maintenance, and provides a consistently green lawn year-round, making it ideal for drought-prone areas and high-traffic zones.
